newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 25.

text.p: -- Philip Morris Cos Inc is expected to provide about $6.5 billion of the initial $10 billion payment called for from the tobacco industry under the settlement between cigarette makers and the states, the New York Times reported. RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp said it expected its initial payment under the accord would be $600 million. Philip Morris closed at 44-3/16 while RJR Nabisco finished at 34-1/2.

-- Boeing Co might change its sole-supplier pacts with three U.S. airlines in a bid to pacify European leaders and to remove major obstacles to its acquisition of McDonnell Douglas Corp, the Wall Street Journal reported. Boeing closed at 55.

-- 3Com Corp reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.48 per share, compared to the year-earlier $0.46 before a pre-tax charge of $0.30. The company said it expected results for its first fiscal quarter ending in August to show slower revenue growth because of slowing sales in Europe and work necessary to merge recently acquired U.S. Robotics Corp. 3Com closed at 49-3/4, then dipped to 48-1/2 in after-hours trading.
